ug.nonAdmin: Only admins can add people or change roles — ask one if you need a hand.
ug.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the people list. Try again in a sec.
ug.mode.linuxHint: Everyone here is a real Linux user. Admins are in the sudo/wheel group; changes run useradd, usermod and chpasswd on the host.
ug.mode.appHint: NoCapOS is running in Docker or on Windows, so it keeps its own accounts. On a native Linux install these become the machine’s real Linux users.
ug.role.admin.hint: Runs the show — full control of NoCapOS
ug.role.admin.hintLinux: Runs the show — full NoCapOS control plus sudo
ug.role.user.hint: Uses apps and files; can’t touch system settings
ug.role.guest.hint: File sharing only — connects from a computer or phone, no desktop
ug.empty.noMatchBody: Try another name, or clear the filters.
ug.empty.aloneBody: Add your people — family, roommates, the team.
ug.empty.groupsBody: Groups keep your people sorted — like Family, Work or Guests. Make one and pick who’s in.
ug.add.title: Add a person
ug.add.sub: They’ll sign in with this user name and password.
ug.add.subLinux: Creates a real Linux account with a home folder and a bash shell.
ug.add.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Longer with a mix is better.
ug.add.groupsHint: Optional — tap to add them to groups.
ug.f.usernameHintLinux: Lowercase — used to sign in to NoCapOS and Linux
ug.v.nameLinux: That user name’s not it — lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter.
ug.v.nameApp: That user name’s not it — use 3–32 letters, digits, ., _ or -.
ug.v.nameTaken: Someone already has that user name.
ug.v.groupTaken: There’s already a group with that name.
ug.pw.note: Resetting signs them out everywhere, so they’ll sign back in with the new one.
ug.edit.roleHint: Switching roles signs them out so it kicks in right away.
ug.edit.selfLocked: You can’t change your own role — ask another admin.
ug.edit.spacesAdmin: Admins can reach every shared folder and app.
ug.edit.twofaOn: They use an authenticator code to sign in.
ug.edit.twofaOff: Not set up — they can turn it on in their own Security settings.
ug.edit.passwordHint: Set a new one and sign them out everywhere
ug.groups.noneYet: No groups yet — make one in the Groups tab.
ug.pg.sub: Tap to put {name} in or out
ug.g.sub: Name it, pick a color, choose who’s in.
ug.g.name: Name
ug.g.membersHint: Tap someone to move them, or drag them across.
ug.g.dropHere: No one yet — tap or drop people here.
ug.confirm.disableBody: They get signed out right away and can’t sign back in until you enable them again. Their files stay put.
ug.confirm.deleteLinux: This deletes the Linux account “{name}” from this machine for real and signs them out of NoCapOS.
ug.confirm.deleteApp: This deletes “{name}” for real: they can’t sign in anymore, and their chats and settings in NoCapOS are gone.
ug.confirm.homeBody: Their home folder and every file in it get erased for good — no undo. Choose Keep files to leave {home} on disk.
ug.confirm.groupBody: Just the group goes — everyone in it keeps their account and files.
ug.toast.addedLinux: Their Linux account and home folder are ready.
ug.toast.enabled: {name} is back — they can sign in again
ug.toast.role.guest: {name} is a Guest now — file sharing only
ug.sp.loadFailed: Couldn’t load their folders and apps
ug.sp.noFolders: No shared folders yet (Files → File Sharing).
ug.sp.adminAll: Admins can always reach every shared folder
